book.name: 1 Korinti
book.title: 1 KORINTI Poruva Korintiqinaahuani hoqarenaa qara vara kyora

content: Mpohuara mwutukya vahiani okyarara tura Qio kyai nte mpoqiavata aanra kyuqeraqaa nrohi okyarara mpo nkyi timwa nyianri.
Nte mpohuara mwutukya vahiani okyarara nkyi timwa nyinrenra. Mwi okyarava vuni vahi okyaravama vahiro.

content.text: Nte mwaa mwataraqaa varihua qua mpo qua mpo qua
qio tiqana nyaamwunyaahua quavata qio qiariro ni
mutukyavanto hia mpohuara vahirera, nte mpo qua
mpo qua qiariva, mwiva qumina vahi nyaamwa
nruquave, taaqa nruqua votima kyeroma vahiananro.
Nte Kotiva qovarama kyaani quara mpo qua mpo qua
timwa nyi variqanave, nte ekyaa qua okyara rieqana
ekyaa uqeta taani quara rienave, nte tiqana, nte Kotira
kepukyara kepukyaqama kyena riemwaqina quariva
qioma taaqi mpo rataa kyaananrove, qiarivavata
variariro mpohuara mwutukya vahiariva hia niqi
vahirera, nte qumina inraikyavanto varianinrave.
Nte Kotirara rieqana ekyaa ntena vataani inraikyara
vehi nraakye qora nyinave, nte kyaariro ni mamanta
qiavanto itamwa kyairarovata mpohuara mwutukya
vahiariva hia niqi vahirera, mwi inraikyava hiama ni
kyaahaqa hiraqe nte quminama mwitaa hianinra.
Mpohuara mwutukya vate okyarava mwataamama
vahiro. Mwia mwutukyavanto mpohuara vahiari
vaisiva hia qamwanrama kyero nkyiari uaqiama
nyataraitiro, mwiva kyuqema kyeqaro mpohuavata
kyaahaqa hiananro.
Mwia mwutukyavanto mporara vahiariva hiama vaisi
mpovanto airi inraikya vataaninranra ua hiananro.
Mwiva hiama nai mwahuta qiananro. Mwiva hiama
nai nrutu tuaheraananro.
Mpohuara mwutukya vahiariva hiama mpohua
mwutukya uaqia hiarintema kyero qua tirove,
nanrianra nraahu rierove, mwia utaqitairo
qamwanrama kyero raraqa taariva nriananro.
Mpohuara mwutukya vahiariva mpohua mwia
uaqiama mwaterara hiama qati nraahu riemwatero
kyaara ntumwaqiro quananro.
Mpohuara mwutukya vahiariva hiama uaqia hi
kyaiqara varaaninranra qamwateqaro variananro.
Mwiva Kotira kyaiqa qutaa kyaiqara qamwateqaro
variananro.
Mpohuara mwutukya vahiariva hia qoriri hiraro
mpohua kyaahaqamaqiro quananro. Mwiva Kotirara
kepukyaqama kyero riemwaqiro quananro. Mwiva
Kotira vekya variqaro Kotira aanraqaa
kepukyaqamaqiro viqaro muaanra vahiani entara
hiama Kotira qaqira kyaananro.
Mpohuara mwutukya vahiani okyarava hiama taiqa
quananro. Mwi okyarava qati nraahu vahiqiro
quananro. Vaisivanto Kotira qua timwa nyiqiro quari
okyarava, mwiva taiqa quananro. Vaisivanto Kotira
qua nraahumwa mpo qua qiari okyarava, mwivavata
taiqa quananro. Vaisivanto mpo okyara mpo
okyarara timwa nyiqiro quariva, mwi okyaravavata
taiqa quananro.
Tire mwaa entara Kotira okyara hia ekyaa mwia
ntapihiraitita, pata mpoqiatana nraahuma ntapihita.
Mate mwaa entara Kotiva nai qua mpoqiatana
nraahu timwa timwihata tire mwiqiatana nraahu
nraakye qora timwa nyi varunanra.
Nraakiara tire
ekyaa inraikyaqi qioqa hiana entava nri ntairaqe tire
hia hini vitiqia nraahu ntapihiarava vahiananrove.
Tire ekyaa inraikya ntapihiananrave.
Nte nraaqiara variqana nte nraaqiara taaqa qua
timwaqina quavaro ni pu naatovanto nraaqiara taaqa
vu nraato vahuvana variqina quavara. Nte mate
nronra tuemwa vina nraaqiara taaqa okyara qaqira
kyena varura.
Tire mate Kotira nraakye qoravanto nraaqiara taaqa
votima kye variqata Kotira okyara hia anoma kye
taqe varunanra. Vaisivanto kyinumiqi hia kyuqema
kyero nai mwanraqura taqaintema kye tire Kotira
okyara taqeqatavata hia ntapihi kye taqaunanra.
Nraakiara tire nai viri nai viri taqeqata ntapihi kye
taqaananra. Nte mate mwaa entara hini qua nraahu
riaariva nraakiara ekyaa qua ntapihi kyena
riaaninra. Kotiva ni okyara ekyaa ntapihi kyero
taqaintema kyena nte ntena okyara ntapihi kyena
taqaaninra.
Taarampo okyaranramwuvantoma qati nraahu
vahiqiro quananro. Kotirara riemwaqiro quari
okyarava vaiharo, Kotira vekya variqata qamwate
okyarava vaiharo, mpohuara mwutukya vahiari
okyarava vahiro.
Mwinramwuhuaqitairo mpohuara mwutukya vahiani
okyarava vunyaa okyarama vahiro.
